title: Transcript entry
description: Entries the loop (C1) appends and the context (C4) sends. A transcript starts with the user goal, then alternates assistant decisions and observations.

finish.description: The terminal action: the model is done and this text is the answer (C1).

action.description: What the model chose to do this step: call a tool, or finish.

userEntry.description: A goal supplied by the human (normalized to text by C7).

assistantEntry.description: One step of reasoning: a thought plus the action it chose.

observationEntry.description: The result fed back to the model. outcome ok/error is recoverable; guard_denied blocks (C3, C8).

tool_call_id.description: The tool call this observation answers, when it is a tool result (C3). Absent for harness-level observations such as a provider timeout.
